# technitium_settings_blocking (Resource)

Manages ad/malware blocking and block list subscriptions.

This is a singleton: declare it once. Attributes left unset follow the server's current value. Destroying the resource only removes it from state; server settings are not reset.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "technitium_settings_blocking" "this" {
  enable_blocking = true
  blocking_type   = "NxDomain"
  block_list_urls = [
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/StevenBlack/hosts/master/hosts",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allow_txt_blocking_report` (Boolean) Answer TXT queries for blocked names with a report.
- `block_list_update_interval_hours` (Number) Block list refresh interval in hours.
- `block_list_urls` (List of String) Block list URLs; prefix `!` for allow lists.
- `blocking_answer_ttl` (Number) TTL for blocked answers.
- `blocking_type` (String) `AnyAddress`, `NxDomain` or `CustomAddress`.
- `bypass_list` (List of String) Clients exempt from blocking.
- `custom_blocking_addresses` (List of String) Addresses returned when `blocking_type` is `CustomAddress`.
- `enable_blocking` (Boolean) Enable blocking.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `settings`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import technitium_settings_blocking.this settings
```
